cover.sub: 5 niche things that will make you annoyingly good at
cover.title: catching bugs before users do

inner.title: watch every deploy
inner.body: google's sre workbook says a majority of incidents are triggered by binary or configuration pushes. your next bug is probably riding in your next release.
inner.label: most incidents

inner.title: ship to 5% first
inner.body: google's canary example sends a change to 5% of users and compares them with everyone else. ship to everyone at once and everyone is your tester.
inner.label: small blast radius

inner.title: hire a robot user
inner.body: synthetic browser tests click through login and checkout as often as every minute, from several locations. without one, your first alert is an angry customer.
inner.label: every minute

inner.title: users don't report
inner.body: in a 2017 us survey of 1,000+ app users, 88% said bugs make them abandon apps. a quiet support inbox is not the same as no bugs.
inner.label: 88% leave

inner.title: count people, not errors
inner.body: crash-free users is the share of people who hit no crash in a period. one user can throw 500 errors while 500 users quietly hit one each.
inner.label: the real score
